purpose: Portable evidence for optional benchmark-only crowd presentation attribution.
interpretationLimits: Attribution adds signal observers, callback delegates, timers, and counters; these runs are diagnostics and cannot enter acceptance timing summaries.
Each accepted diagnostic is one run on a shared host. Differences are descriptive and do not establish an optimization gain.
Main process and skeleton callback timers are overlapping or adjacent boundaries and must not be summed into an exclusive frame breakdown.
Mirrored handler counters are known source invocation estimates, not intercepted totals of CombatPresentation3D.update_pose.
Headless wall time is a scene CPU proxy; renderer CPU/GPU metrics are unavailable.
